title: Israeli Strikes Kill 10 in Nuseirat and Gaza City Police Station, Two Days After US Asked Israel to Draw Down Attacks
detail: Israel carried out two separate strikes in Gaza on August 19, 2026. The first hit central Gaza's Nuseirat refugee camp, killing one person the IDF identified as a Hamas company commander who took part in the October 7, 2023 attack. Less than half an hour later, the military struck a police station in Gaza City, killing nine — including eight police officers and 13-year-old Dana al-Jamasi — and wounding 15. The IDF said 'at least four terrorists from the military wing' of Hamas were present at the targeted location. The strikes came just two days after US negotiators reportedly asked Israel to draw down attacks in Gaza during Jared Kushner's visit, and the Board of Peace remained conspicuously silent on both strikes. Hamas spokesperson Hazem Qassem said the Board of Peace has provided 'cover' for Israel to escalate its attacks instead of pressuring it to abide by the ceasefire.

title: IDF Opens Criminal Investigation Into Killing of 5-Year-Old Hind Rajab, Admits Troops Fired on Her Family's Car
detail: The Israeli military ordered a criminal investigation into the January 2024 killing of 5-year-old Hind Rajab, acknowledging for the first time that its troops fired on the vehicle carrying Rajab's family — reversing its earlier claim that no forces were present in the area. Rajab's final moments, pleading with Palestine Red Crescent dispatchers by phone as she hid in the car surrounded by the bodies of six relatives, drew global outrage after the recording was released. The IDF said in a statement that, 'following review of the findings and due to alleged failures in the coordination of the movement of the Palestine Red Crescent ambulance, it has been decided to initiate a criminal investigation of the incident.' The probe is part of the IDF General Staff's Fact Finding and Assessment Mechanism, which has now concluded reviews of 150 incidents since the war began. Rajab's mother, Wesam Hamada, called the investigation a 'long-overdue step' but said 'justice has not yet begun.'

media.caption: IDF opens criminal probe into the January 2024 killing of 5-year-old Hind Rajab
